Agent.description: The tool, pipeline or person that produced a sidecar or a file.
Agent.title: Agent

BatchDescriptor.description: Identity of the deposit the sidecar describes.

batch_id.description: Contributor-assigned batch ID, unique within the source.

register_version.description: Version or snapshot identifier of the source register the descriptor was issued from. On a sidecar: the register version the batch was drafted against.

source_id.description: The source register ID. Must match the delivery role used for upload.

supersedes_batch.description: batch_id of the batch that this batch corrects or extends.

profiles.description: Implementation guides or profiles pinned, e.g. "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core|6.1.0".

CcdaConformance.title: CcdaConformance

CdmSource.description: Fields of the OMOP cdm_source table that a lane 1 load needs.
CdmSource.title: CdmSource

CompanionRef.description: A companion file that holds part of the sidecar (file entries or subject rows) as JSON Lines.

key.description: Object key relative to the batch prefix.

record_count.description: Rows, resources or documents in the file, when counted.

CompanionRef.title: CompanionRef

Conformance.description: The standard a group follows and the version and profiles pinned for it.

profiles.description: Implementation guides or profiles pinned, e.g. "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core|6.1.0".

Extension.description: A namespaced, project-specific key-value pair. Unknown fields anywhere else fail validation; tools that rewrite sidecars preserve extensions.
Extension.title: Extension

ExternalId.description: An identifier assigned to a file by another system.
ExternalId.title: ExternalId

FhirConformance.description: Helper class for rules. Conformance with standard FHIR.

profiles.description: Implementation guides or profiles pinned, e.g. "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core|6.1.0".

FhirConformance.title: FhirConformance

FileEntry.description: One data object in the batch.

file_id.description: Stable UUID for the file. See FR-6.

key.description: Object key relative to the batch prefix.

record_count.description: Rows, resources or documents in the file, when counted.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity facts. On the header they apply to every file; on an entry they override.

subject_ids.description: Subject IDs the file contains. Each must appear in the subject table.

supersedes_file.description: file_id of the entry this file replaces when content changed.

FileEntry.title: FileEntry

FileFormatEnum.description: The physical format of a file, as detected or declared.
FileFormatEnum.title: FileFormatEnum

FileGroup.description: A set of files that together form one collection defined by a spec or by the contributor.

export_time.description: For FHIR bulk exports, the transactionTime of the export.

FileGroup.title: FileGroup

FileLink.description: A relation between two files that no declared spec defines.

origin.description: Origin of the link: declared, detected (from a data dictionary), or inferred (needs confirmation).

FileLink.title: FileLink

file_id.description: Stable UUID for the file. See FR-6.

record_count.description: Rows, resources or documents in the file, when counted.

role.description: The member's role in the group: OMOP table name, FHIR resource type, FHIR bundle type (transaction, collection, batch, document), C-CDA document type, or a free table name for tabular datasets.

GroupTypeEnum.description: The kind of collection a group of files forms.
GroupTypeEnum.title: GroupTypeEnum

IdSystemEnum.description: How subject IDs in the subject table were obtained.
IdSystemEnum.title: IdSystemEnum

InteractionEnum.description: The payload interaction a batch requests (plan section 3.2 and 7.5).
InteractionEnum.title: InteractionEnum

ModalityEnum.description: The kind of data a file carries. Decides the NORMALIZE lane together with the group conformance. Values match the modality table in the requirements.
ModalityEnum.title: ModalityEnum

OmopConformance.description: Helper class for rules. Conformance with standard OMOP_CDM.

profiles.description: Implementation guides or profiles pinned, e.g. "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core|6.1.0".

OmopConformance.title: OmopConformance

key.description: Object key relative to the batch prefix.

ProcessingHint.description: An informational key-value pair for a pipeline. Pipelines may read hints but must not branch on them (FR-5); anything decision-bearing is a schema field.
ProcessingHint.title: ProcessingHint

Provenance.description: How a file, group or sidecar was derived. Maps to W3C PROV.
Provenance.title: Provenance

SensitivityDeclaration.description: Facts about the payload that de-identification and routing need. Policy (use terms, access tier, date policy) is not declared here; it comes from the source register. Defaults, where a flag is absent, are the most restrictive reading.

contains_biometric_identifiers.description: Payload holds biometric identifiers, full-face images, voice or similar. Held in the TRE only.

contains_dates.description: Payload holds dates finer than year (accepted, masked at release).

contains_free_text.description: Payload holds unstructured text that de-identification must scan.

contains_zip_codes.description: Payload holds postal codes (accepted, masked at release).

direct_identifiers_removed.description: Contributor attestation that Safe Harbor direct identifiers (plan Table 3, group one) were removed before transmission. Must be true for non-synthetic data.

synthetic.description: Payload is synthetic data with no real persons. Relaxes identifier checks to warnings.

SensitivityDeclaration.title: SensitivityDeclaration

Sidecar.description: The metadata sidecar for one batch. Serialized as _rddc_sidecar.json.

files.description: File entries, inline. Mutually exclusive with files_ref.

files_ref.description: Companion JSON Lines file holding the file entries, with its checksum.

generated_by.description: The tool or pipeline that wrote the sidecar, with its version.

schema_name.description: Name of the schema this document conforms to. Always rddc-sidecar.

schema_version.description: Version of the sidecar schema the document conforms to.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity facts. On the header they apply to every file; on an entry they override.

sidecar_id.description: Unique ID of this sidecar document. Referenced by supersedes in later sidecars.

subjects.description: Subject table rows, inline. Mutually exclusive with subjects_ref.

subjects_ref.description: Companion JSON Lines file holding the subject table, with its checksum.

supersedes.description: sidecar_id of the sidecar this one replaces (correction, rectification or addition).

Sidecar.title: Sidecar

SourceDescriptor.description: Register values for one source, issued by the ACT at onboarding and consumed by the generator and the local validator (FR-28). Serialized as rddc_source.yaml or .json. Not part of the sidecar document.

delivery_role.description: Identifier of the delivery role (for example an IAM role ARN) the source uploads with. Informational for the contributor; enforced by the platform.

issued_by.description: Who issued the descriptor (the ACT, or the register export job).

modalities.description: Modalities the source is registered to deposit. A sidecar file with another modality fails the registry check.

prefix_pattern.description: Template for batch prefixes under the bucket, with {source_id} and {batch_id} placeholders, ending with a slash. Example: "{source_id}/{batch_id}/".

register_version.description: Version or snapshot identifier of the source register the descriptor was issued from. On a sidecar: the register version the batch was drafted against.

schema_version.description: Version of the sidecar schema the document conforms to.

source_id.description: The source register ID. Must match the delivery role used for upload.

SourceDescriptor.title: SourceDescriptor

StandardEnum.description: Standards a group can declare conformance to.
StandardEnum.title: StandardEnum

StorageLocation.description: Where the batch lives. The prefix ends with a slash and the sidecar sits directly under it.

prefix.description: Key prefix of the batch, ending with a slash. Empty string for bucket root.

StorageLocation.title: StorageLocation

SubjectEntry.description: One row of the subject table.

consent_ref.description: Reference to a consent record or version for this subject, for consent batches.

identifier_system_uri.description: For fhir_patient_identifier, the identifier system URI.

subject_id.description: The contributor's coded ID for one person.

SubjectEntry.title: SubjectEntry

ValueOrigin.description: Provenance of one auto-filled field value in an entry or group.

confirmed.description: A human confirmed the value. Required true for inferred values before validation passes.

field.description: JSON pointer or dotted path to the field within the entry or group.

method.description: Detector or rule that produced the value.

ValueOrigin.title: ValueOrigin

ValueOriginEnum.description: Where an auto-filled value came from.
ValueOriginEnum.title: ValueOriginEnum
